title: A backup row says Backup in the Type column and has one Restore… whose dialog chooses Everything (first) or Files only with the uploads warning; Create a backup's title is a field pre-filled with the date and time behind a fixed "Backup N ·" prefix, and a typed title is stored without a second number; a drafted note line never shows mention markup; after Restore everything the restore row names its Before-restore backup as its return point and no separate row sits above it
steps: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): ORIGIN (= O), COOKIE_DOMAIN, DSH, A and seat A's cookie COOKIE_A, api. Case variables: S = qa1wp01.scv2.tracy.test (a WordPress site seat A owns); RUN=$(date +%s).

Check the build: docker exec $DSH grep -c 'restore.scopeFilesWarning' /desk-home/profiles/native/node_modules/@tracy/dsh-site-tabs/lib/client.js must print >= 1, and docker exec $DSH grep -c 'data-title-prefix' /desk-home/profiles/native/node_modules/@tracy/dsh-site-tabs/lib/client.js must print >= 1; otherwise stop with BLOCKED note image-older-than-reg019-prefix.

Unit seam: node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern="Restore… on a backup|Create a backup: the title is a field|Create a backup: a title typed with its number|Create a backup with long notes|Create a backup before the backups answer|restoreScopes|mentioned an element|an element block|a page block|nothing names it|not on lines of its own|recorded before the host cut" packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/e2e/changes-v2.test.mjs packages/core/tracy-core/test/backup-list.test.mjs packages/core/tracy-core/test/mention.test.mjs packages/core/tracy-core/test/activity-v2.test.mjs packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/moment.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/prompter.test.mjs
A full backup to look at: api a POST /api/sites/<S>/backup '{"title":"REG-019-point-'$RUN'","notes":""}' (HTTP 200, database.state 'full', else BLOCKED); N = body.version.

Browser: chrome-watch and Playwright as in the README (connectOverCDP, a NEW context {locale:'en-US', colorScheme:'light', viewport:{width:1440,height:1000}} with A's cookie, never close anything); log every POST whose path ends with '/restore' or '/backup'. Open Site changes of S (README § Open Site changes) and wait for li.tv-backup[data-backup='<N>'] (README § Find a row in Site changes).

Row: record TYPE = trimmed text of li.tv-backup[data-backup='<N>'] [data-cell='source'] .tv-activity-cell-text. Click li.tv-backup[data-backup='<N>'] button.tv-activity-event-main until aria-expanded is 'true'; record BUTTONS = the trimmed text of every [data-restore] in its [data-detail].

Dialog: click the detail's [data-restore='backup']; wait for '[role=dialog] [data-scope-choice]'; record OPTIONS = for each [role=dialog] [data-scope-option]: [its data-scope-option, its input's checked, its trimmed text]; record HEAVY = whether '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-word]' exists. Click '[role=dialog] [data-scope-option="files"] input'; wait until '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-word]' is gone; record DIALOGS = number of [role=dialog] elements. Press Escape and wait until no [role=dialog] remains.

Create a backup — the title field: click [data-create-backup]; wait for '[role=dialog] [data-title-prefix="number"]' (<= 30 s); record PREFIX = its trimmed text, FIELD = the value of #tracy-backup-title, EDITABLE = whether #tracy-backup-title is editable, EXTRA = the number of '[role=dialog] [data-title-edit], [role=dialog] [data-title-save], [role=dialog] [data-title-cancel]' elements. Record NOTES = the value of '[role=dialog] [data-draft]' once it is not empty (<= 30 s; empty is allowed when nothing changed since the newest backup).

Type a title: fill #tracy-backup-title with 'REG-019-title-'$RUN; click the dialog's 'Create backup' button; wait until no [role=dialog] remains; record POSTED = the title in the body of the logged POST …/backup made by that click; wait (<= 60 s) for li.tv-backup[data-backup='<N+1>'] and record NAME = its [data-name] text.

Mention in a request: on the Browser tab of S pick an element (Comment), type 'REG-019 make this bold '$RUN and send it to Tracy; wait for the turn to end (<= 180 s; no reply needed). Reload Site changes of S; record ROW = the trimmed Description text of the newest row whose text contains 'REG-019 make'. Click [data-create-backup]; record LINE = the line of '[role=dialog] [data-draft]' that contains 'REG-019 make' (or null). Close the dialog with Escape. If the turn cannot run (no model key: QUOTA/402) or records no row, record ROW = LINE = 'skipped' — the unit seam covers the mid-line and squeezed forms either way.

Restore everything and its return point: api a POST /api/sites/<S>/restore '{"mode":"everything","version":<N>,"idemKey":"reg019-'$RUN'","confirm":"restore"}' (curl -m 300; HTTP 200 status 'succeeded', else BLOCKED); then api a GET /api/sites/<S>/backups and record R = the version of the newest row whose title is 'Before restore to Backup <N>'. Reload Site changes of S; record EV = the [data-event] of the newest li whose [data-cell='description'] text starts with 'Restored everything to Backup <N>', DESC = that text, BEFORE_ROW = whether li.tv-backup[data-backup='<R>'] exists, ABOVE = the [data-event] of the li right before EV in document order (or null); click EV's button[aria-expanded] and record BACK = the trimmed text of its [data-detail] [data-restore-return='<R>'] (or null). Open the Jump to backup menu ([data-jump]) and record JUMP = whether a menuitem names 'Before restore to Backup <N>'; press Escape.
Record RESTORES = the number of logged POST …/restore requests.
expect: The build check prints >= 1 twice; the unit seam exits 0 with '# fail 0'.
TYPE === 'Backup' (before #812 the Type cell held the archive icon alone).

OPTIONS: [['everything', true, 'Everything'], ['files', false, 'Files onlyImages uploaded after this backup are removed; posts that use them will show broken images.']]; HEAVY === true (Everything opens on the type-the-word-Restore dialog); DIALOGS === 1 (Files only swaps the content in the same window).
PREFIX === 'Backup <N+1> ·'; FIELD matches \d (the date and time in the viewer's words) and does not contain 'Backup'; EDITABLE is true; EXTRA === 0 (no Edit link, no Save or Cancel of its own).
POSTED === 'REG-019-title-<RUN>' (no number in it); NAME === 'Backup <N+1> · REG-019-title-<RUN>': the number reads once.

NOTES contains none of '```tracy-', '<mentioned-element', '<page ', '>', '<', '"', '&'. ROW and LINE (unless 'skipped') contain 'REG-019 make this bold' and none of those markup strings; a block that is not on lines of its own reads as the chip's words or '[element]' (unit seam: mention.test, moment.test, prompter.test, activity-v2.test).

DESC === 'Restored everything to Backup <N> · Return point: Backup <R>'; BEFORE_ROW === false (no separate Before-restore row); ABOVE is not 'backup-<R>'; BACK === 'Restore Backup <R>…'; JUMP === true (still listed where backups are chosen). Note: the RESTORES expectation below counts only the dialog's POSTs, not this api call.
RESTORES === 0 (the restore dialog was closed without confirming).
evidence: packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/e2e/changes-v2.test.mjs (Restore… on a backup; Create a backup: the title is a field from the start; a title typed with its number is stored once), packages/core/tracy-core/test/backup-list.test.mjs (restoreScopes), packages/core/tracy-core/test/mention.test.mjs (replaceMentions), packages/core/tracy-core/test/activity-v2.test.mjs (a request recorded before the host cut mention markup), packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/test/moment.test.mjs and packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/prompter.test.mjs (a block not on lines of its own), packages/core/tracy-core/test/backup-list.test.mjs (a Before-restore backup folds into its restore row), apps/tracy-web/test/backup-restore.test.mjs (returnPoint)
fence: packages/core/tracy-core/src/site-tabs/BackupRow.tsx renders one [data-restore=backup] and the word Backup in the Type cell; RestoreBackupDialog.tsx holds one dialog whose ScopeChoice picks Everything (first) or Files only (with restore.scopeFilesWarning) from restoreScopes (backup-list.ts); BackupDialogs.tsx CreateBackupDialog draws an InputGroup: [data-title-prefix] (t(backup.name, {n, title: ""}), or backup.titlePending) before #tracy-backup-title (value: typed ?? stampTitle(now)); Create posts stampTitle(new Date()) when untouched, else storedTitle(), which strips a leading "Backup N · ". A request's tracy-element/tracy-page blocks are said in the chip's words by @tracy/core/mention replaceMentions: the host records the turn title through personWords(content, {mentions: "label"}) (prompter.mjs, moment.mjs), and Site changes reads older rows through readableRequest (activity-v2.ts describe(), ActivityEventRow). tracy-web keeps the host's beforeRestore.version in site_operation.scope.beforeRestore (operations.js finishOperation) and serves it as description.params.returnPoint (activity-v2.js); mergeTimeline (backup-list.ts) folds that backup into the restore row (ActivityEventRow returnPoint, data-restore-return).
